description: Add a version to a project, at the end of its sequence. A version is what a project's work goes out in — '2.4.0', 'Autumn'. It is the project's own: an issue carries versions of its own project only, any number of them ('fixVersions' on create_issue, update_issue and get_issue; JQL 'fixVersion = "2.4.0"', 'fixVersion in unreleasedVersions()'). The name is unique in its project, whatever the case. Answers with the version as list_versions gives it. Releasing it is release_version's. Project lead or admin only.

description.description: What is in it, in a sentence.

releaseDate.description: The day it is meant to ship, as YYYY-MM-DD.

startDate.description: The day work on it starts, as YYYY-MM-DD.

name: create_version
